name: Shiretoko
description: Shiretoko is a remote peninsula on the northeastern tip of Hokkaido, Japan, whose Ainu name means "end of the Earth." Drifting sea ice reaches here farther south than anywhere else in the northern hemisphere, feeding a rich web of life. Salmon run up its rivers, Steller's sea lions and whales visit its waters, and the rare Blackiston's fish owl hunts along the streams.
